_comment: WHAT THIS IS. Which files to lay out on the players' machine. Every available type is shown here — keep the ones you need and delete the rest. 'solution' is for the GM only (it goes into the cheatsheet), 'hint' is what you can drop at the table.
title: My Quest — main layout

files._type: plain text — a note or an instruction
files.solution: Entry point: tells the players about 'помощь' and 'связь'.
lines: 1. Commands for your area — type: помощь
2. Link to the duty system — type: связь

files._type: event log — background of the story
key file: reading it switches the stage (see stages.json)
files.solution: Reading this file moves the party to the 'finale' stage.
lines: A note found in the archive.
Hint here where to go next.

files._type: compressed file under a misleading name: file → gunzip -c
files.solution: Extension .txt, gzip inside. Solve with: file → gunzip -c index.txt
files.hint: cat shows garbage — so it is not a text file.
lines: What the players learn by unpacking it.

files._type: picture under a misleading name: the code is drawn on it

notes.Opis: A note inside the file — visible with strings.

files.solution: It is a PNG: file → mv map.dat map.png → open it. The code is {{door_code}}.
files.hint: What is called a map is not a map.
files._captions_note: The built-in font is Latin only: Cyrillic will not render. Use Latin letters and digits.

lines: What the players read once they decode it.

files.solution: Solve with: rev code.txt. A fallback path to the code {{door_code}}.

files._type: archive under a misleading name: unzip
files.solution: It is a zip. Solve with: file → unzip -l attachment.log → unzip
A plain tar. Solve with: tar -tf backup.tar, then tar -xf

files._type: file with no read permission: chmod +r. Does not work as root!
files.solution: Mode 000: cat refuses. Solve with chmod +r. NOTE: as root the file reads anyway — play as a normal user.
lines: What the players read once they restore their read permission.
